title: The Daily Life of a Middle-Aged Online Shopper in Another World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ken'ichi Hamada, a 38-year-old freelance manga artist, is transported to a fantasy world where he can still order goods from an Earth shopping site. He sells and buys modern products to build a quiet country life, gathering a household of love interests including the merchant's daughter Primura, whom he marries, and cat beastwomen. He also takes in Anemone, a 12-year-old rescued from bandits, as an adoptive daughter who says she wants to be his future wife.
life_message: A comfortable, self-made slow life with a loving household is the reward of practical cleverness and kindness.
